decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Document 34 Date 20 June 2021 Time 13:23 2021 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 17 -20 June 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 30), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The floor has been changed and is of a different specification, changes have also been made to the setup of the suspension.
offence: Breach of Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed floor is of a different specification from the one used during qualifying, the floor was replaced with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate as per Article 34.2. Changes have also been made to the setup of the suspension. As the changed floor is a different specification and changes have been made to the setup of the suspension whilst the car was in parc ferme, the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane per Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 22 Parc Ferme
